queries.result: Search identified the official Egyptian General Survey Authority (ESA) site and its digital-map service, but no public Minya Al-Qamh parcel viewer or parcel API was found.

queries.result: Search found a Minya Al-Qamh real-estate registration-office listing and official ESA material describing Egypt’s surveying and map-production role. No first-party Arabic cadastral viewer or anonymous parcel API was found.

registryBasis: Egypt’s official Egyptian General Survey Authority states that it creates and maintains topographic/property maps and cadastral records and publishes a digital-map ordering workflow. The Arabic discovery also identifies a Minya Al-Qamh real-estate registration office, but no open parcel-data endpoint is evidenced.

officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official ESA history describes creation of maps and property books for agricultural land and built property; services include digital maps, coordinate certificates, and boundary separation. No open parcel layer is advertised.

Official digital-map page requires a customer request specifying location, scale, layers, format, and projection, followed by quotation and payment. It is a procurement workflow, not a public parcel API.
Official directorate page is a static image map of Egypt with links/areas, not a JavaScript parcel viewer or machine-readable geometry service.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Directory listing for Minya Al-Qamh real-estate registration office
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Lists a local real-estate registration office in Minya Al-Qamh; directory evidence only and no parcel layer or API.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Official ESA home page inspected. Service links include digital maps and directorate map, but no parcel service endpoint was exposed.
Official page inspected; HTML contains a static Egypt image map and ordinary site scripts only. No WMS/WFS/REST/ArcGIS endpoint, parcel layer, schema, or CRS declaration.

Official digital-map procurement page inspected. It describes requesting GIS/CAD/PDF/JPG/orthophoto products with a specified projection, but publishes no downloadable parcel response or anonymous query route.
Official paper-map sales page inspected; maps are sold through ESA map rooms/directorates. No public parcel geometry service.
Local office listing reviewed for custodian discovery only; no service request made and no parcel data exposed.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Egyptian national surveying/map custodian and Minya Al-Qamh registration-office discovery.

geometryDecision: No GeoJSON retained. No qualifying safe anonymous native parcel ID-plus-geometry response was available from an official Minya Al-Qamh/Egypt service. The exact WUP point was not used to infer absence.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel or survey identity if publicly exposed
remainingUncertainty: A public parcel viewer/API may exist outside the reviewed ESA pages or may require an ordinary official procurement workflow. Public parcel-layer schema, CRS, exact-point inclusion, and citywide coverage remain unverified.
nextStep: A serial reviewer should independently check whether ESA, the Sharqia surveying directorate, or the local real-estate registry exposes a current anonymous geometry service, then qualify a small geometry-only sample before any adapter consideration.
